thread:
InfraBot: :rotating_light: Detected elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/chat/stream (region: us-east-1). Auto-pager: @oncall.SRE.
Eli R: looking at traces now. p95 jumped from 700ms -> 2.9s right after a deploy. p99 spikes to ~18s. Lots of downstream 502/504s from proxy.
Tara V: deploy tag `v2026-03-15-batcher-async` rolled out 8m ago (timestamp 3629990800). Canary passed basic health but not tail-latency stress.
Kenji H: sampling worker logs: batcher worker reports "batch wait > 200ms" and then request cancellation. Suspect batching change introduced head-of-line blocking.
Maya T: customer impact check: CS-Bot reports 3 priority tickets from enterprise customers and a spike in telemetry showing 4% error rate for embedding flows. Notified Support.
Eli R: quick telemetry snippet: ```2026-03-15T18:02:10Z proxy[gw-12] WARN upstream_timeout 504 count=47; 2026-03-15T18:02:11Z worker-7 ERROR request_canceled wait_ms=210```
Kenji H: also seeing KV cache lock contention in wasm-kv shim: lock_waits increased x6. That could amplify batching delays.
Tara V: mitigation options: 1) scale inference-workers (fast but may mask the bug), 2) toggle batcher async flag off (requires rollback of feature flag), 3) full rollback to previous runtime. Which first?
Eli R: do immediate mitigation with least blast radius: disable async batcher flag via FF toggle. If that fails, rollback. I'll flip toggle now.
DeployBot: Feature toggle update requested by @Eli R: `featureflag batcher.async=false --env=prod --region=us-east-1`
DeployBot: Toggle applied (id: ff-3629991). Propagating.
InfraBot: Observability update: 60s after toggle p95 improved slightly, but p99 still elevated and we continue to see queueing.
Kenji H: toggle reduced batch wait median but didn't eliminate long-tail stalls. Lock contention still high. Could be combined effect of new batching coexisting with older kernel path.
Maya T: CS update posted: "We're investigating elevated timeouts impacting a subset of requests. Engineers are actively mitigating; we'll post an update in 30m."
Eli R: decision time: toggle didn't fully fix. Rollback recommended to be safe. Tara, can you start rollback runbook?
Tara V: initiating service rollback to `v2026-03-14-stable` for us-east-1. Kicking RB job.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated by @Tara V: `rollback inference-service --to v2026-03-14-stable --region us-east-1` (rb-id rb-3629992). Estimated switch-over 2m.
InfraBot: Begin post-rollback watch: 10m window.
Kenji H: logs during rollback show worker restarts; eviction rates on KV cache return to baseline within ~90s. Proxy 502s drop.
Eli R: monitoring: p95 back to ~0.78s within 3 minutes, p99 down to ~2.1s. 5xx rate back under 0.5%.
Maya T: confirmed CS tickets updated. No customer data exposure. Impact window estimated 10m full impact, hump persisted ~20m including investigation and rollback.
DeployBot: Rollback rb-3629992 completed at 3629991460. All traffic on v2026-03-14-stable for us-east-1.
Eli R: immediate action items: 1) Open hotfix PR to revert batching change and add synthetic tail-latency canary tests (owner Kenji), 2) Add pre-deploy mem/lock contention smoke for canary (owner Tara), 3) Add automatic fail if `batch_wait_ms > 150` for first 5m of canary (owner Eli).
Kenji H: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/batcher/pull/987-revert-async-batcher. Includes extra logs and debug timers.
Maya T: drafted internal incident note for support: "Root cause: async batcher change increased head-of-line waits and KV lock contention, producing tail latency regressions. Mitigated by rollback. Hotfix and stronger canary checks in progress."
Eli R: schedule postmortem doc and tag eng-runtime, eng-ml, and infra. Please upload heap/dump/profile artifacts to incident artifacts. Kenji, capture the sequence that creates lock contention.
Kenji H: collecting profiles and flamegraphs; uploading to https://artifacts.redwood.internal/3629991234/batcher-profiles.
Tara V: adding new canary gate in CI: fail rollout if `p99_latency_increase > 2x` or `batch_wait_ms > 150ms` in canary window. Will push shortly.
InfraBot: Handoff reminder: current oncall @Eli R until 19:00 PT; next oncall @Kenji H at 19:00 PT. Attach incident notes to oncall rotation.
Eli R: closing active pager, leaving incident open for follow-up and postmortem. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
